headline: Felician stand alone unbeaten in conference play
dek: Jefferson's win at Wilmington ended the leaders' unbeaten run in conference play, and Felician are now the only side without a conference defeat. All four of Felician's losses came against non-conference opponents, in a season that also holds six wins and eight draws.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Goals have not decided the table: Bridgeport have scored 41 and conceded 35, in a season of seven wins, three draws and seven defeats.

wire.line: Goldey-Beacom are still without a conference win, and Felician are still without a conference defeat.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Gijs van Eif has scored nine goals for Georgian Court and assisted eight more, from 67 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Mathias Kristoffersen has kept nine shutouts for Felician and conceded ten goals all season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Goldey-Beacom have conceded 58 goals, more than any other programme in the conference, in a season of one win, three draws and fourteen defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Dane Bodziak has scored eight goals for Chestnut Hill from eighteen shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Bruno Mestres has made 97 saves for Holy Family and conceded 22 goals.

last_match.line: Holy Family have not lost since their defeat at Jefferson; Chestnut Hill have lost every match since beating Dominican.

next_match.line: Holy Family won the sides' conference meeting on this ground; Bridgeport have scored more goals than any other side in the conference.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
